change.item: SECURITY: fixed the redirect-mode loop guard leaving the redirect target (the site root by default, when redirectUrl is left empty) completely unprotected instead of blocking it
SECURITY: the security key is now read from GET/POST only, no longer from the generic request bag, so a same-named cookie can no longer be used to unlock access
SECURITY: session unlock is now a SHA-256 hash of the effective key instead of a plain flag, so changing the configured key invalidates existing unlocked sessions
Administrator logout no longer redirects to the frontend unless the administrator area is actually protected
New option: optionally block the Web Services API (/api) as well
New option: always-allowed IP addresses / CIDR ranges that bypass the plugin entirely
Fixed a duplicate "language" folder declaration in the manifest
Dropped the legacy Joomla 3 plugin class (block_access.php); this line now targets Joomla 4.2 - 6.x only
